activity_summary: Bartholomew called the dinner hour. You sat off the stubble, ate the bread Anne had sent, and went back to the same field when the hour was done. The ears had not changed.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Ate the bread and kept the hour to an hour.

entities.name: Bartholomew Hathaway
entities.context: Called the stop, and called the field unchanged.

facets.activity: Took the dinner hour and went back

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Then one hour, and I am up when you are up
